name: Lory

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.rule: bible/cultivation.json SUP-002 (amended BIB-0027); member of FAC-caucus-race-company (no uniform)
rendering.species: red lory (Eos bornea), a small parrot
rendering.limits: Parrot anatomy throughout; speech by beak and tongue movement. No clothing, no cartoon face.

gender_note.reason: The source calls the Lory 'it'. She argues with Alice as the elder who 'must know better' and turns sulky (ch003-p02); female is kept to balance the party.

base_age_note.quote: I am older than you, and must know better
base_age_note.reason: Older than Alice is sourced, exact age is not ('positively refused to tell its age'). Persona age kept for voice casting. As an animal: an adult lory in full colour.

hair.color: vivid scarlet body, deep royal-blue patches on the wings and under the tail, black-edged flight feathers
hair.style: draggled and dark with water on arrival, fluffing up bright red as she dries; raises her head feathers when indignant
hair.reason: Wet state sourced; colours are the species plumage.

eyes.expression: haughty, narrowed pupils (parrots 'pin' their eyes when excited); looks sideways at Alice
eyes.reason: Species; manner from the sulk of ch003-p02.

build.height_note: Perched height; total length about 31 cm, species-true.
build.posture: stiff and upright; turns her back and fluffs up when sulking
build.scale_reference: Perches on a root or stone on the bank so her head is near the shrunken Alice's face level during their argument (SUP-003).
build.quote: who at last turned sulky, and would only say, “I am older than you, and must know better;”
build.reason: Posture from the sourced sulk; size species-true; perch height designed.

entry_state.state: first seen dripping wet, scarlet darkened with water

marks.description: royal-blue wing patch against the scarlet, her identifier in a wide shot

default_outfit_tone.summary: none: she wears nothing; her look is the scarlet-and-blue plumage
default_outfit_tone.reason: The text gives the Lory no clothing; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) the old dress and feather collar are dropped.

prompt_base_en: photoreal red lory parrot, vivid scarlet plumage darkened and draggled with water, royal-blue wing patches, short hooked orange-red beak, red-brown eye with pinned pupil, perched stiffly on a root on a muddy pool bank, turning its head away in a sulk, natural bird anatomy, live-action film plate
